task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First stop, take the type N passkey from the basket within the salon. Then, go to the south. After that, unlock the type N gate. And then, make absolutely sure that the type N gate is open. And then, try to go to the east. Then, head north. And then, go east. Then, take a trip south. Then, attempt to move south. Then, make an effort to go to the south. After that, take a trip east. And then, travel north. And then, make an attempt to travel east. With that done, pick up the keycard from the floor of the cookhouse. That's it!
